title: Figure 4: Brain-controlled robot closed-loop visual feedback experiment (Duke to Japan)
description: Composite figure with a cartoon illustration of a monkey's head with "Neural Recording" signal frames, a "Network Interface Architecture" arrow linking Duke University (USA) to a humanoid robot and "Multi-level autonomous control" with a JST Japan logo. On the right is a photograph of a humanoid robot standing in a lab beside a display screen. The caption "Figure 4. Experimental Overview of Brain-Controlled Robot in a Closed-Loop With Visual Feedback Experiment" describes walking data decoded from a monkey on a treadmill being relayed from Duke to a research lab in Japan.
